ruleToc.chapterList: @js:(function(){try{var j=JSON.parse(String(result));var vols=j.list||[];var list=new Packages.java.util.ArrayList();for(var i=0;i<vols.length;i++){var cs=vols[i].bookChapters||[];for(var k=0;k<cs.length;k++){var c=cs[k];if(!c.cdnUrl)continue;var u=(String(c.cdnUrl).indexOf('http')===0?String(c.cdnUrl):'http://book-resources.cread.com/'+String(c.cdnUrl).replace(/^\/+/,''));var ver=(c.version===undefined||c.version===null)?'0':String(c.version);var nm=String(c.name||('第'+(c.idx||c.chapterindex||'')+'章'));list.add(JSON.stringify({name:nm,url:u+'?bid='+(c.bookid||'')+'&cid='+c.id+'&v='+ver}));}}return list;}catch(e){return new Packages.java.util.ArrayList();}})()

ruleExplore.bookList: @js:(function(){try{var j=JSON.parse(String(result));var d=j.dataList||(j.data&&j.data.dataList)||[];var list=new Packages.java.util.ArrayList();for(var i=0;i<d.length;i++){var b=d[i];var o={name:String(b.newBookName||''),author:String(b.authorName||''),kind:String(b.categoryName||''),wordCount:String(b.wordCount||''),intro:String(b.intro||''),cover:String(b.cover||''),bookUrl:(b.bookid?'https://cxb-pro.cread.com/cx/bookDetailYS?bookid='+b.bookid:'')};list.add(JSON.stringify(o));}return list;}catch(e){return new Packages.java.util.ArrayList();}})()
